scope: Fixed selected years and source windows spanning 1900 through 2100, not a continuous inventory of that span. Horizons coverage is sparse; NASA covers every retained catalog row in the selected years.
matching: Unique identity inside the independent source window for Horizons, or kind and full TT catalog date for NASA, before comparing timing or classification. Ambiguous candidates are not assigned.
rounding: Raw millisecond errors decide timing acceptance. Absolute and mean errors round up to seconds; signed extrema round outward. Empty measurements are null.
counting: Totals count query-reference comparisons, including repeated comparisons across policies and equivalent longitude/aspect queries, not distinct sky events. Unmatched ambiguous candidates remain in unmatchedResults.
